visual.general_description: Grayscale frontal infant chest radiograph without visible tubing and an L marker.
visual.detailed_description: Grayscale frontal chest radiograph of an infant including clavicles, shoulders and upper arms. A large white letter L is printed in the upper right; a small white partial mark is at the left edge. No tubes or wires are visible over the chest. Both lung fields show dark air-filled areas with ribs and hazy gray patchy regions, more hazy in the lower parts of each side; the spine and mediastinum are seen near the middle. No arrow overlay, names or dates are printed. The arrangement looks the same as the radiograph in Figure 6 of the article, which carries an overlay arrow; no text states they are the same image.
